q: How do we count goods we buy and donate?
title: Donated goods: which scope
short: Count goods you buy to donate as purchased goods, Scope 3 Category 1, in the year you buy them. If you donate your own products, their production is already in your Scope 1 and 2. Use of sold products and end of life cover sold goods, so donated items usually stay out of them.
audience: CSR teams and companies donating products

ul: Blankets bought for a relief drive: Category 1.
Your own food products given to a food bank: production already counted.
Transport you pay for to deliver them: Category 4.

p: If donations are large, note them so readers see why purchases rose without sales.

senseible: Senseible keeps purchase invoices on the Scope 3 trail with the category, method and factor source on every line, so spend-based estimates are labelled as estimates and can be replaced with supplier data later.
